traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The demon has advantage on saving throws against
spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The demon’s weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The demon’s spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). The demon can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * At will: darkness, fear, detect magic * 1/day each: confusion, sleep

traits.name: Rend and Tear
traits.text:
The demon has advantage on all melee weapon attacks
against a creature it is grappling.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The demon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two
with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17).
Until this grapple ends, the demon can bite only the grappled creature and
has advantage on attack rolls to do so.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage.
